publication issues.summary: Early partial, unapproved V4: converter reports 168 unresolved render cells, including 36 wire-glyph differences, and 10 uncertainties. Report differences are truncated; the separate padded comparison has 214 differences. All differences and uncertainties remain unresolved pending native review. Full native-resolution routes, crossings, endpoints, missing-wire and registration review has not been performed. External schema validation was not run; source and electrical correctness are unestablished. Team8 later reports external Draft 2020-12 schema validation passed with zero errors for this exact V4; the prior not-run statement describes the earlier handoff. Parent and helper sampled a top output crop showing a hollow diamond and RT707 branch at +D BIT15; TXT positions [204,2]/[204,3] versus inferred [203,2]/[203,3] remain unresolved without independent registration. Other wiring differences and full routes/omissions remain unreviewed.
